panel_statistics.lower_quartile_note: Not reported for this degraded three-reviewer panel; no interpolated pseudo-score is used.

consensus.improvement: Removing the runtime-independent portability claim raised the technical and experimental assessments to 6 while retaining a bounded one-stack result.
remaining_major_issues: The single-stack case limits the demonstrated significance and reusability of the audit integration.
The assurance hierarchy must distinguish complete receipt replay from independent recapture, end-to-end validation, and protection against pre-capture common-mode errors.
The incremental value over a conventional targeted test suite needs a more direct statement.
The pre-output frozen-identity target must be reconciled with the original run's failed terminal recursive code-tree closure.
Independent numerical checks and live faults remain selected, captured-input, positive-control evidence rather than broad coverage.
direct_revision_actions: Define full as conditional completeness within a registered target boundary and state the trusted-capture boundary.
Explain the additional typed lifecycle, storage, call, accounting, and fault records required beyond ordinary pass/fail tests.
Clarify the pre-output identity versus terminal package-closure distinction in Table 5 and the reproducibility statement.
Keep targeted faults consistently labeled as positive controls.
experiment_dependent_actions: Broader preregistered operator sampling or a representative independent end-to-end check.
A held-out mutation suite if fault coverage becomes a central claim.
A second stack only if the paper later chooses to claim portability; it is not required for the current bounded reference-stack claim.

invalid_assignment_reviews.reason: The initial prompts did not distinguish the top-level snapshot identity from the PDF byte SHA-256. The initial reviewers therefore treated two intentionally different identifiers as a critical mismatch. Those reviews are excluded because of the assignment error, not because their scores were unfavorable.

degraded_mode.reason: The collaboration thread limit prevented two additional fresh replacement contexts. The novelty replacement is fresh; the technical and experimental reviews are complete identity-corrected reruns in their original reviewer contexts.
degraded_mode.consequence: Round 20 is an informative three-role PDF-only panel, not a full five-reviewer skill-compliant round and not a completion-gate result.
